verdict.rationale: Veo's docs say it turns text prompts into short videos and lets users refine results across multiple turns via the Interactions API, including multi-turn conversational editing such as element replacement or perspective changes (veo-docs-8, veo-docs-9). Camera, lighting and cinematic parameter controls support targeted adjustments (veo-docs-6), and a hands-on preview user confirms prompt-to-video generation works (veo-comm-13-refresh-0f3b2e8e5b5e7075). However, community reports note imperfect prompt adherence, and the migration notice leaves it unclear which model the multi-turn refinement applies to. missing for 10: hands-on corroboration of multi-turn iterative editing, clarity on whether refinement applies to Veo itself rather than the successor Gemini Omni Flash model, reliable prompt adherence across iterations.
